claims.claim_text: Refusal to allow the use of political pretexts to disenfranchise American citizens.
Commitment to prohibit training exchanges between U.S. law enforcement and global military and policing entities.
Opposition to any attempts to create race-based governments within the United States.
Rejection of proposals to continue George Bush's economic policies.
Rejection of sweeping claims of "inherent" presidential power.
President Obama's administration recognizes that one size does not fit all.
Strong opposition to the Kyoto Protocol and similar mandatory carbon emissions controls that harm economic growth and destroy American jobs.
The current administration's efforts have encouraged anti-Americanism.
Opposition to any U.S. domestic government that is not bound by the U.S. Constitution or Bill of Rights.
Rejection of U.N. Agenda 21 as erosive of U.S. sovereignty.
Commitment to oppose Republican plans to slash funding and block grant Medicaid and SNAP, which would harm millions of Americans.
Opposition to the policy of Mutually Assured Destruction.
